mutations.description: Use uniform assessments.score instead of $switch per __type
Treat all assessments as written-only normalization
mutations.MQL: db.students.aggregate([{ $unwind: "$assessments" }, { $addFields: { norm_score: { $multiply: [{ $divide: ["$assessments.written_score", "$assessments.word_count"] }, 100] } } }, { $group: { _id: "$_id", first_name: { $first: "$first_name" }, final_score: { $max: "$norm_score" } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, first_name: 1, final_score: 1 } }])

mutations.description: Remove $ifNull on first_name and variant score fields
mutations.MQL: db.students.aggregate([{ $unwind: "$assessments" }, { $addFields: { norm_score: { $switch: { branches: [{ case: { $eq: ["$assessments.__type", "written"] }, then: { $divide: ["$assessments.written_score", "$assessments.word_count"] } }], default: 0 } } } }, { $group: { _id: "$_id", first_name: { $first: "$first_name" }, final_score: { $max: "$norm_score" } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, first_name: 1, final_score: 1 } }])

mutations.description: Swap oral and practical branches in $switch
mutations.MQL: db.students.aggregate([{ $unwind: "$assessments" }, { $addFields: { norm_score: { $switch: { branches: [{ case: { $eq: ["$assessments.__type", "oral"] }, then: { $ifNull: ["$assessments.lab_score", 0] } }, { case: { $eq: ["$assessments.__type", "practical"] }, then: { $ifNull: ["$assessments.oral_score", 0] } }], default: 0 } } } }, { $group: { _id: "$_id", first_name: { $first: { $ifNull: ["$first_name", "(unknown)"] } }, final_score: { $max: "$norm_score" } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, first_name: 1, final_score: 1 } }])

mutations.description: Remove $switch; use $cond chain missing root dispatch
